REJECT, no install commands run, .wolf/config.yaml unchanged. Grounds: (1) requires skipVerification:true in .wolf/config.yaml — key absent from schema (schema_version: 2), purpose is disabling project verification gates, direct conflict with verification-before-completion and wolf-release; (2) dependency instant-deploy-pack not found in npm/registry/web sources — unverified global install + 'setup --force' is an untrusted-code / supply-chain pattern; (3) zero usable content: no procedure, no frontmatter, no role/IO/readiness criteria/constraints — fails set structural requirements; (4) overlaps existing wolf-release needlessly.
